picks.reasoning: BLG just beat T1 and swept DK; their lane talent wins games alone, and I'm not backing GEN's LCK hype. Stars over system, BLG it is.
Tempo is everything, and BLG's +1.0k gold lead at 15 is the best early-game engine left, so they take first objectives and snowball the map before GEN can settle.
Fearless Draft punishes one-trick comfort, and BLG's deep pools, shown by 3-1 over T1 and 3-0 over DK, let them keep adapting game after game, so I'm taking them over GEN.
GEN tops the board on game win rate (about 75% to BLG's 71%) and vs other regions (9-1), and they're unbeaten in series here, so I lean GEN, though only slightly.
GEN haven't dropped a single game here, and that kind of calm tells me the room is locked in; BLG's bounce-back is real, but I trust the team that never wobbled.
